{{Quote|You've never faced my kind before.''"<br />"''No. You've never faced ''my kind'' before.''"<br />"''We'll see.|Mighella, and Darth Maul|<ref name="Darth Maul (2000) 4">[[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]]</ref>}}
As a test of his recently completed [[Sith training|training]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was sent by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], on a '''mission to Ralltiir''' to exterminate the leadership of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.

==The battle==
After defeating a legion of Black Sun elite forces on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], Maul was faced with the bodyguards of the [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]], which he defeated easily. He then proceeded to slaughter every last Vigo residing there. After Darth Maul had decimated all of the ranks of the criminal Black Sun organization, he planned to complete his task by [[Death/Legends|killing]] their leader, [[Alexi Garyn]].

[[File:TheDeathofAlexiGaryn.jpg|thumb|left|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] kills [[Alexi Garyn]].]]

[[Mighella]], [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] and Garyn's personal body guard, attempted to act as her liege's last line of defense, and confronted the pursuing [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the bowels of Garyn fortress on Ralltiir. The two masters of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] then engaged each other, Mighella with her darksword, and Darth Maul with his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Mighella's sword eventually broke after absorbing repeated blows from the Sith Lord's weapon, at which time she blasted him with a barrage of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. Maul, however, was able to withstand the Nightsister's assault, and proceeded to [[Sai tok/Legends|slice her in half]] with his lightsaber, ending both the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] and her life.

Maul then had a brief conversation with Garyn, who correctly deduced that Maul was a Sith. Maul then killed Garyn by grabbing him the throat and drowing him in a small body of water, but not before the latter wounded the Sith Lord by slashing him across the left hand with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|virboblade]].

==Aftermath==
The only survivor to escape Maul's slaughter was the late Alexi's retainer, [[Oolth]], who tried to get word of Maul's attack to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Unfortunately, he was killed by [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bats]] before he was able to reach his goal.

Sidious was pleased with Maul for completing the mission, but he expressed anger and reprimanded his Apprentice for revealing to Garyn that he answered to a Master and that the Sith were planning to rule the galaxy after Garyn correctly deduced that Maul was a Sith, as the Sith would have faced severe repurcussions if Garyn had managed to escape alive with this damaging information.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
